an4.163:2.1: katamā ca bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā
an4.163:2.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.163:2.3: maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.163:2.4: so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati
an4.163:2.8: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ anantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya
an4.163:2.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā.
an4.163:3.1: katamā ca bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā
an4.163:3.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asubhānupassī kāye viharati āhāre paṭikkūlasaññī sabbaloke anabhiratasaññī sabbasaṃkhāresu aniccānupassī
an4.163:3.3: maraṇasaññā kho panassa ajjhattaṃ supaṭṭhitā hoti
an4.163:3.4: so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati
an4.163:3.8: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ anantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya
an4.163:3.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dukkhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
an4.163:4.1: katamā ca bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā
an4.163:4.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.163:4.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetasoekadibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.163:4.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.163:4.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.163:4.6: so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati
an4.163:4.10: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ muduttā dandhaṃ anantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya
an4.163:4.11: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā dandhābhiññā.
an4.163:5.1: katamā ca bhikkhave sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā
an4.163:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati pītiyā ca virāgā …pe… tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
an4.163:5.3: so imāni pañca sekkhabalāni upanissāya viharati
an4.163:5.7: so imesaṃ pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ adhimattattā khippaṃ anantariyaṃ pāpuṇāti āsavānaṃ khayāya
